## What this dashboard shows

- A forward-looking financial dashboard combining historical constant-currency revenue analysis (YTD Jan–Jun 2026 vs 2025), ML-driven revenue forecasts through Dec 2026, and scenario stress-testing for FX and input cost sensitivity across Wipro Enterprises' five business units.
- Total revenue in scope grew **₹87.96B (+18.0%)** on a constant-currency basis YTD Jan–Jun 2026, reaching **₹583.00B**; Feb–Jul 2026 revenue reached **₹573.93B**, up **₹72.77B (+14.5%)** year-on-year.
- The dashboard integrates data from nine source systems (Real SAP BDC, Simulated SAP, SAP S/4HANA systems A & B, Oracle EBS, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Tally Prime) covering Consumer Care & Lighting, Infrastructure Engineering, and Joint Ventures.

## What to report

- Consumer Care & Lighting drove **₹57.32B (78.8%)** of the Feb–Jul growth, with Wipro Consumer Care International contributing **₹47.15B (65%)** overall; fastest growth was **USC1 US Corporate at +181.7% (₹8.20B)** and **F1US US Retail at +63.1% (₹34.84B constant-currency)**.
- FX translation added **₹5.48B** to reported YTD Jan–Jun growth; US operations benefited most (**1710 +₹2.62B, F1US +₹2.11B**), while **WIN2 Europe declined -₹2.12B (-13.4%)** and requires attention.
- Under the current scenario (INR -5%, input cost +3%), FY2026 outlook shows **Wipro Consumer Care International ₹68.57B above guidance**, but **Consumer Care India, GE Healthcare, and Kawasaki all short** (₹6.68B, ₹1.91B, ₹3.88B respectively); group total **₹1111.38B is within range but at risk**.
- Margin sensitivity analysis shows EBITDA would drop **₹19.14B** under the stress scenario (from **₹681.86B to ₹662.72B**), with Consumer Care India most exposed (**-₹10.59B**) due to input cost pass-through, while Consumer Care International gains **₹5.65B** from FX translation.

## Watch out for

- **Simulated data flagged**: dashboard includes "Simulated SAP" and "Simulated" SAP S/4HANA sources; verify whether these reflect actual committed transactions or planning assumptions, and clarify coverage for board reporting.
- **WIN2 Europe contraction**: the entity posted **-₹2.12B (-13.4%)** constant-currency decline YTD and **-₹3.20B** drop Feb–Jul; investigate whether this is market-driven, operational execution, or a one-time event, and confirm recovery actions.
- **ML forecast backtest error of 9.9% MAPE** for the GROUP model; ask whether individual entity accuracy varies materially (only GROUP error shown) and whether Aug–Dec forecast incorporates known pipeline or assumes trend continuation.
- **Working capital calculator shows ₹38.26B cash release** from modest 15-day improvements, but Jul 2026 balances may include seasonal peaks; validate whether DSO/DPO targets are sustainable year-round and aligned with customer/supplier contract terms.
